subject: Eval roadmap & MAP — owners + timing confirmation
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena@finworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-06T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + draft MAP from today’s call

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and to make it easy to share internally:

- Primary use case: Customer-facing summarization for support tickets (1–3 paragraph answers).
- Success criteria: < 800ms p95 for 512 tokens, cost target ~$0.006/token after batching/quantization, fidelity to knowledge base.
- Evaluation window: 3 weeks recommended with 3 canonical prompt sets (support triage, escalation, canned responses).

Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (FinWorks_MAP_v1.pdf) with proposed owners, dates, and checkpoints. High level:
- Week 0: spin up eval infra (Redwood Dedicated trial) — Owner: FinWorks infra lead
- Week 1: endpoint + prompt set validation — Owner: Elena / Carlos
- Week 2: quality review & runtime tuning — Owner: FinWorks PM

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm the owners on page 2 and whether the proposed dates look realistic for your team.
2) If budget/priority shifted, tell me and we’ll compress or expand the schedule.

I’ll follow up mid-next week if I don’t hear back — want to keep momentum while your procurement window is open.

Thanks,
Connor
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Quick nudge on MAP owners/dates — flexible on schedule

Hi Elena —

Just waving a quick hand as a follow-up — open question: are the owners/dates in the MAP workable, or should we shift any checkpoints?

If priority has dropped internally, we can give you a longer evaluation window or do a smaller scoped proof-of-value first (e.g., only the triage prompt set). If this is still on-track, a one-sentence confirmation of owners + proposed kickoff date is perfect.

If helpful, I can loop Carlos directly or book 20 minutes with your infra PM this week to unblock scheduling.

Thanks,
Connor

Ben / Marissa —

Quick note: Elena acknowledged but hasn’t confirmed owners. If I don’t get a reply by EOD Friday (4/16) I’m planning to:
- Offer a narrowed POV (triage prompts only) to reduce infra ask and speed decision.
- Propose a short intro call with Carlos (engineering) — Marissa, can you take point for a technical 20-min sync?
- If still no engagement by 4/23, suggest we mark as low priority in pipeline and revisit after their quarter close.

Let me know if you want alternative escalation (e.g., cc’ing an exec sponsor).

Connor

Hi Connor —

Appreciate the nudge. Apologies for the delay — we had an internal prioritization review. Confirming owners below and a tentative kickoff date:

- Infra owner: Carlos Mendez (cc’d)
- PM owner: Elena Ramos (me)
- QA/ops: Maya (on our team; I’ll intro in next email)
- Proposed kickoff: 2026-04-26 (week of) — ok to start with just the triage prompt set as a scoped POV.

Carlos — can you confirm the infra readiness for the week of 4/26? If that looks tight we’ll shift to the following week.

Connor — thanks for offering the narrowed POV. Let’s proceed with that — please send an updated MAP that reflects the scoped deliverables and adjusted dates.

Elena
